_note: Fully synthetic values (no names, GPS, device serials or personal ids). The answer has the shape of Garmin's /fitnessstats-service/activity answer as garminconnect's get_progress_summary_between_dates(start, end, metric) returns it (a list with one item; stats -> activity type -> metric -> count/min/max/avg/sum). Pins: distance min/max/avg/sum are in centimeters. Running max 1,301,000 cm = 13.01 km.
